title: Cross-environment Master Data synchronization (same tenant)
summary: Cross-environment Master Data Management now allows subsidiary environments to synchronize master data from a source environment within the same tenant via an authenticated ODataV4 API, with capability negotiation, resumable streaming, inline media support, and OAuth2 transport.
key_points: New IMDM Data Source interface with Local and Cross-Env implementations for flexible data source routing
Source-side generic API with GetCapabilities, GetRecords (paged change feed), and LastModifiedAtPerTable for change detection
OAuth2 client-credentials HTTP transport with in-session token cache and 429 backoff handling
Media and Blob fields sync inline as base64 with per-field 512 KB cap to avoid SystemModifiedAt conflicts
Connection Details wizard for setup similar to Intercompany, with security audit logging and mandatory privacy consent
quote: Extends Master Data Management from same-environment, company-to-company sync to cross-environment sync within the same tenant.
